meta.name: skill-optimizer
meta.description: SkillOpt-flavored offline training loop for any SKILL.md. Treats accumulated learn-rule corrections as training trajectories, proposes bounded patches via an optimizer LLM, gates each candidate against a held-out validation set built from the user's own past corrections, and ships only candidates that demonstrably improve the score. Inspired by Microsoft SkillOpt's ReflACT pipeline (rollout → reflect → aggregate → select → update → evaluate) adapted to pro-workflow's SQLite store. Use when a skill has accumulated 8+ learn-rule rows and the user wants the skill itself to get better, not just longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 这个技能会分析你积累的修正记录，像训练AI模型一样优化技能文件。它会提出增删改建议，只采纳能提升效果的修改，最终自动更新技能内容。
howto.when: 当某个技能积累了8条以上的修正记录，并且你觉得技能变得臃肿或重复时，可以运行此技能进行离线优化。

say.text: 优化我的“翻译助手”技能，它最近总是重复规则。
say.note: 技能会读取该技能的修正记录，开始优化流程。

say.text: 对“代码审查”技能运行优化，预算0.3美元。
say.note: 指定预算上限，避免过度消耗。

say.text: 查看上次优化“写作助手”技能的结果。
say.note: 技能会从数据库读取历史运行记录。

howto.what_en: This skill analyzes accumulated correction records to optimize a skill file like training an AI model. It proposes additions, deletions, and replacements, accepts only changes that improve performance, and automatically updates the skill content.
howto.when_en: Use when a skill has accumulated 8+ correction records and you feel the skill is bloated or repetitive. Run this skill for offline improvement.

say_en.text: Optimize my 'Translation Assistant' skill; it keeps repeating rules lately.
say_en.note: The skill reads correction records and starts the optimization process.

say_en.text: Run optimization on 'Code Review' skill with a budget of $0.30.
say_en.note: Sets a spending cap to avoid overuse.

say_en.text: Show results from the last optimization of 'Writing Assistant' skill.
say_en.note: The skill queries the database for historical run records.
